profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ BAE Systems | Computer Engineering Graduate @ University of Maryland
profile.summary:
I am a Class of 2024 graduate from the University of Maryland with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering. I currently work full time as a Software Engineer at BAE Systems, where I focus on building maintainable and reliable software systems.

Before transitioning into my full-time role, I completed two Software Engineering internships at BAE Systems, where I used C++, C#, and XAML to enhance and maintain existing applications. These experiences strengthened my ability to write maintainable code, understand large codebases, and collaborate across engineering teams in a defense-industry environment.

During my time at UMD, I also served as a Research Assistant with the Parallel Software and Systems group, contributing to performance analysis of GPU and parallel applications using Python and Pandas. This role reinforced my technical curiosity and provided insight into working within a structured, research-oriented team.

I’m passionate about continuing to grow as a software engineer, learning from experienced teams, and contributing to projects that value clean design, scalability, and long-term impact.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Helped lead the revival of a 2-year inactive program, which had no existing organization in place.
Proactively managed discussions between the Club Sports office and team members.
Helped lead efforts to re-connect with external leagues, internal gym schedule organizers, fundraising, and recruitment Depts.
Helped organizedsafety officer team within the organization and attended safety training courses.
positions.insights: Skills: Time Management · Teamwork · Organization Skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern II
positions.description:
BAE Systems Inc. is an $11 billion Aerospace and Defense subsidiary of BAE Systems PLC. I worked within the Electronic Systems Sector, where I performed integral tasks on both the front and back end of the Mission Data File Generator (MDFG) User Interface. The MDFG project focused on improving the Radar Warning Receiver and enemy threat detection on aircraft such as the F-16 and C-130J.

Performed a range of coding work within Visual Studio, primarily using both Visual C# and XAML.
Inspected code for bugs, made design improvements and implemented them.
Designed code to track bugs in real time.
Highly collaborative environment with frequent team meetings and travel to nearby BAE sites.
positions.insights: Skills: Telerik · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · C# · Git · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · XAML

projects.title: Language Translator

Utilization of regular expressions (regex) to parse through files and capture words, grammar, and lexicons. 
Generated sentences and created sentence translations from one language to another language using the data gathered and stored.
